text:
alex.k: Incident reported ~12:05 PT — quick marketing coordination ask: we need a short customer-facing update for status page + in-app banner. Who can take copy and timing?

maria_s: On it. Do you want a shortform alert only or short + detailed follow-up?

alex.k: Shortform first (status + banner) then a targeted email for paying customers once we have RC/ETA. Timing: status + banner ASAP, email 60–90m after root cause confirmed.

josh_o: Ops note: looks like a DB failover cascade causing increased API latency. Mitigation in progress; rough ETA to stable ~2h. Recommend phased messaging.

riya_cust: Phased makes sense. Keep the public copy non-technical. For paying customers include support contact and mitigation tips in the follow-up.

marketing-bot: Draft short status copy suggestion:
```
We’re investigating increased API latency affecting a subset of requests. Our team is working on mitigation and performance should improve soon. We will post updates within 30 minutes and send a follow-up to affected customers.
```

maria_s: Small edits: replace "time out" language with "may experience delays", add support link and opt-in for priority updates.

alex.k: Agreed. Final short form for status + banner (ready to publish):
```
We’re investigating increased API latency affecting a subset of requests. Mitigation is underway and performance should improve soon. Updates in ~30 minutes. If your app is impacted, contact support: https://redwood.ai/support (Reply "Priority" to this thread for priority notifications.)
```

maria_s: Looks good. I’ll publish the status page entry and push the in-app banner now. Email draft for paying customers incoming for review.

riya_cust: Email subject suggestion: "Redwood Inference — Service update: latency affecting some requests". Will prepare short, empathetic body + next steps.

josh_o: Ops will reconfirm RC/ETA in 20m. If ETA slips beyond 2h, we should include offer for credits in the follow-up messaging.

alex.k: Action items: maria publish status + banner (ASAP); josh update with RC/ETA in 20m; riya prepare email draft but hold send; alex will assemble priority customer list and notify CS leads.

maria_s: Publishing now :rocket:

ops_bot: Status page update published by maria_s at 1968754350

alex.k: Thanks all — keep updates short. I’ll ping when we have confirmed RC/ETA and when email can go out.
